Quantum 1.35.0 was certified on 2026-09-20. It pins **nucleus v1.30.1**, **quark v1.15.0** and **orbit v1.10.3**, with 23 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.34.0: nucleus goes from v1.30.0 to v1.30.1 (patch), quark goes from v1.14.0 to v1.15.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.10.2 to v1.10.3 (patch). 22 sibling modules change version.
